instruction: Go to the page containing information on DMV office locations.

metadata.explanation: This variation asks the agent to navigate to the DMV office locations page on Virginia DMV website. The evaluator uses the existing is_expected_active_tab_approximate metric which ignores query parameters, allowing for flexible URL matching while still verifying the correct page is reached. This is similar to the original task in terms of difficulty (single-page navigation on same website). No custom functions needed as we use existing evaluator functions.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Binary: 1.0 if URL matches the locations page (ignoring query parameters), 0.0 otherwise
